_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits in the Anxiety coil with supportive liquidity offset by dead spot demand; 77.9% bottom analog is diverging so it cannot relocate the rung, and base-rate favors HOLD absent a named breaker.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split — analyst explicit HOLD/Anxiety; narrative flow drop is descriptive only, no contrary forward phase
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC remains rangebound with F&G ~40-55, funding flat, and ETF flows/CVD failing to trend
next_move.invalidated_if: sustained ETF-flow and CVD rebound with upside momentum (toward Disbelief) or vol spike plus reserve-led breakdown (toward Denial)
